title: SCORPION X Lead Prioritization Reproducibility Suite (5 Models)

balanced_default.description: Baseline ranking excluding uncalibrated hemolysis safety (w_hemo = 0.00)

potency_focused.description: Heavy weight on experimentally measured lowest MIC (w_mic = 0.75)

safety_focused.description: Exploratory safety ranking imputing unassayed candidates at neutral 0.50 (w_hemo = 0.20)

stability_focused.description: Exploratory safety ranking penalizing unassayed candidates at 0.15 (w_hemo = 0.20)

equal_weights.description: Equal 25% weights across MIC, stability, hydrophobic moment, and charge
